svg.text: Clear space: at least one ledger-line height on every side. Minimum digital mark: 24px; use the simplified favicon at 16px.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The mark identifies the Sales Ledger product only. It is not a Ford or Bob Maxey dealership logo and must not imply manufacturer endorsement.
